scenario.case_file: Priya Raman, 21, told family they were hiking the standard route from Cooper Spur. Vehicle at the trailhead. Overdue since 08:00.

late_evidence.text: A message on their phone, sent at 06:40, reads: "heading over the back side first, will loop round after" -- recipient unidentified.

frames.trigger_reason: 52% of the mass predicted by 'Lost hiker, down-drainage' has been covered with no contact

nominations.label: [oracle] true account
nominations.narrative: The subject never intended the stated route and crossed to the far side of the divide before beginning the described hike.
nominations.rationale: diagnostic: derived from withheld ground truth
